egg_development_days_20c.notes: Approximate egg hatching time at 20 C.

first_oviposition_midpoint_days_20c.notes: Midpoint of the reported approximately 21-24 day first-oviposition window; this is not a direct single-age measurement.

high_food_interclutch_median_days.notes: Approximate median interval under high-food treatment; interval is strongly food- and age-dependent.

adult_lifespan_days_20_21c.notes: Longevity is strongly temperature-dependent; no single species constant should replace the current calibrated runtime cap.

mean_clutch_size_observed.notes: Mean across observed clutches in the cited feeding/age study; not a fixed per-event fecundity.
mean_clutch_size_observed.conditions: Laboratory study spanning food treatments and maternal ages.

first_clutch_mean_high_food.notes: Approximate mean first clutch under ad libitum/high-food treatment; diet dependent.

body_mass.summary: Adult dry mass has a direct recent laboratory anchor; carbon is derived from a generic dry-mass carbon fraction and is therefore not measured.

adult_dry_mass_mg.notes: Approximate dry mass for medium-sized adults aged 25 ± 3 days in that culture.

adult_carbon_mg.notes: Derived from 0.04 mg dry mass using an assumed 45% carbon fraction; conversion is not species-specific.

water_dependence.summary: Highly water-permeable cuticle; reproduction is more moisture-sensitive than survival. Runtime water-pool mapping remains calibrated.

thermal_response.summary: Development and reproduction vary strongly with temperature; around 21 C is a useful response center, not a universal optimum.

reproduction_response_center_c.notes: Approximate reproductive-response center used by the model; temperature response is broad and nonlinear.

predators: Dalotia coriaria in MVP predator-prey interactions

reproduction_reserve_fraction.notes: Runtime reserve gate for egg production.

feeding_carbon_rate.notes: Model ingestion coefficient calibrated with lifecycle/body-carbon constraints; not directly measured.

runtime_maturity_days.notes: Placed in the measured 21-24 day first-oviposition window.

runtime_reproduction_interval_days.notes: Current 7-day runtime simplification is consistent with the approximate high-food median inter-clutch interval; age/food dependence is intentionally not collapsed into a measured species constant.

runtime_clutch_size.notes: Current runtime calibration. Literature reports substantially larger typical clutches under many laboratory conditions; do not silently overwrite this value.

egg_carbon_mg.notes: Material allocation per egg; must remain jointly constrained by fecundity and adult mass.

runtime_adult_lifespan_days.notes: Provisional runtime lifespan near 20-21 C; literature shows strong temperature dependence.

notes: Highest-priority proposal: recalibrate clutch-size/reproduction dynamics against direct clutch distributions without replacing the current calibrated value until population-level regression targets are agreed.

adult_length_mm.notes: Order-of-magnitude adult body length used for rendering; morphology varies with age.

stage_differences: Eggs are spherical/ovoid; juveniles are smaller, otherwise adult-like; adults increase in size through molts.
render.locomotion_style: Fast substrate walking with occasional springing escape.
reference_images_asset_notes: Use microscopy references; avoid making springing frequency an ecological rate without locomotion measurements.
